title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126966)
description: CVE-2026-126966 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in SmarterTools SmarterMail affecting the svcDomainAdmin.asmx endpoint. It allows authenticated remote attackers to escalate privileges due to missing authorization checks. The flaw enables attackers to access resources normally restricted to higher-privileged users.
